normal.en: In computing, an attribute is a field attached to an object, a named property given to it.
normal.cn: 在计算机中，attribute 是附到对象上的字段，是给对象的具名属性。

abstract.en: Abstractly, attribute is a giving relation: a cause, credit, quality, authorship or blame is given to a subject.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，attribute 是一种给予关系：原因、功劳、性质、作者身份或责任被给到一个主体。

abstract.en: The direction is always from predicate to subject: the property is attached to the thing, not the other way round.
abstract.cn: 方向总是从属性到主体：性质被附到事物上，而不是反过来。

abstract.en: So the verb and the noun are two sides of one relation: to attribute is to give; an attribute is what has been given.
abstract.cn: 所以动词和名词是同一种关系的两面：attribute 是给予；attribute 是被给予之物。

examples.en: She attributes her long life to a simple diet.
examples.cn: 她把自己的长寿归因于简单的饮食。

examples.en: The software stores each file's attributes separately.
examples.cn: 软件把每个文件的属性单独存储。

examples.en: Patience is an important attribute of a good doctor.
examples.cn: 耐心是好医生的一项重要品质。

dict_mnemonic.text: “阿吹比特”——阿吹比特把胜利的标签贴到守门员身上 → attribute 归功于、属性

root: 拉丁语 attribuere“分配、归给” = ad-“向”+ tribuere“给予”，源自 tribus“部落划分”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of attribute, all built on one giving relation: a cause, credit, quality, authorship or blame is given to a subject. The noun names whatever has been given; the adjective and grammar senses name the giving of a property.
sensesIntro.cn: attribute 的九个义项都建立在一个给予关系上：原因、功劳、性质、作者身份或责任被给到一个主体。名词指被给出之物；形容词和语法义指性质的给予。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a label reading 'belongs to him' is stuck onto a cause or quality.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张写着“属于他”的标签，被贴到某个原因或性质上。

branches.en: CAUSE AND CREDIT: an effect, success or fault is given to a person or factor.
branches.cn: 原因与功过：结果、成功或过错被给到某人或某因素。

branches.en: QUALITY: a characteristic is said to belong to a subject, and the noun names it.
branches.cn: 性质：某种特征被说成属于主体，名词则指这个特征。

branches.en: GRAMMAR AND LOGIC: a modifier or predicate gives a property to a subject.
branches.cn: 语法与逻辑：修饰语或谓词把性质给到主词。

branches.en: COMPUTING: a named data field belongs to an object.
branches.cn: 计算机：具名数据字段属于某个对象。

branches.en: AUTHORSHIP: a work is given to an author.
branches.cn: 作者身份：作品被归给某位作者。

intro.en: Attribute builds attribution, attributable, attributive and misattribute. The -ion, -able and -ive suffixes are productive; mis- reverses or corrupts the giving.
intro.cn: attribute 构成 attribution、attributable、attributive、misattribute。-ion、-able、-ive 是能产后缀；mis- 表示错误地给。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is built on tribuere 'to give, allot' and tribus 'tribe, division': tribute, contribute and distribute all describe ways of giving.
latinIntro.cn: 这一拉丁词族建立在 tribuere“给予、分配”和 tribus“部落、划分”上：tribute、contribute、distribute 都描述不同的给予方式。

items.meaning: the act of saying who or what something belongs to
items.meaningCN: 归因；归属；作者认定（-ion 构成行为或结果名词）
items.example: The attribution of the painting is disputed.
items.exampleCN: 这幅画的作者归属存在争议。

items.meaning: able to be explained by or credited to
items.meaningCN: 可归因于的（-able 表示“能被……的”）
items.example: Most of the increase is attributable to tourism.
items.exampleCN: 增长的大部分可归因于旅游业。

items.meaning: placed before a noun to modify it; grammatical
items.meaningCN: 定语性的（-ive 构成形容词，语法用语）
items.example: In 'stone wall', stone is attributive.
items.exampleCN: 在 stone wall 中，stone 是定语。

items.meaning: in an attributive way
items.meaningCN: 作定语地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The noun is used attributively here.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词在这里作定语使用。

items.meaning: to attribute something wrongly
items.meaningCN: 错误归因（mis- 表示“错误地”）
items.example: People often misattribute success to talent alone.
items.exampleCN: 人们常把成功错误地只归因于天赋。

items.meaning: a wrong attribution
items.meaningCN: 错误归属（mis- + attribute + -ion）
items.example: The misattribution was corrected by historians.
items.exampleCN: 历史学家纠正了错误的归属。

items.meaning: said to belong to or be caused by
items.meaningCN: 被归因的；被认定的（-ed 构成分词或形容词）
items.example: The attributed cause was mechanical failure.
items.exampleCN: 被归因的原因是机械故障。

items.meaning: the act of assigning a cause or quality
items.meaningCN: 归因过程（-ing 构成分词或动名词）
items.example: Attributing motives to others is risky.
items.exampleCN: 把动机归给别人是有风险的。

items.meaning: the value stored in a computing attribute
items.meaningCN: 属性值（attribute + value 复合名词）
items.example: The attribute value is set to true.
items.exampleCN: 属性值被设为 true。

items.meaning: an especially important quality or property
items.meaningCN: 关键属性（key + attribute 复合名词）
items.example: Reliability is the key attribute of the system.
items.exampleCN: 可靠性是该系统的关键属性。

latinEntries.meaning: a payment or honour given to another
latinEntries.meaningCN: 贡品；致敬（来自 tribuere“给予、分配”）

latinEntries.meaning: to give together with others
to give out in parts
a social division or group
latinEntries.meaningCN: 部落；族群（来自 tribus“罗马人的划分”）

definition_zh: 可获得的；可用的；有空的；可购得的
definition_en: able to be obtained, used, or reached
core_image: 货架上摆着一件随时可以拿走的东西
scene: 店员站在货架前，指着那排电池。 The shop assistant said this battery is available and there are still three boxes in the stockroom.
sceneCN: 这里 available 是「可购得的、有现货的」（第 6 个义项：可以买到）；句意：店员说这款电池有现货，仓库里还有三盒。

pos.zh: 可获得的；可用的；有空的；可购得的

forms.label: 比较级（更多用 more 构成）

senses.title: Able to be obtained
senses.titleCN: 可获得：能够拿到
senses.definition: able to be obtained or acquired
senses.definitionCN: 能够被获得或取得
senses.example: Tickets are available at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 门口有票可买。
senses.why: Available is built from avail 'be of worth or use' + -able 'can be'. If something can be availed of, it can be obtained and used.
senses.whyCN: available 由 avail“有价值、有用”+ -able“能被……”构成。某物能被利用，就能被获得和使用。

senses.title: Able to be used
senses.titleCN: 可用：能够派上用场
senses.definition: able to be used for a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 能够用于某个目的
senses.example: Only two rooms are available for the event.
senses.exampleCN: 只有两个房间可用于这次活动。
senses.why: The word moves from obtaining to using. What can be got can also be put to work; availability is the state of being usable.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从“获得”移到“使用”。能拿到的东西也能派上用场；available 状态就是可用状态。

senses.title: A person who is free
senses.titleCN: 有空的：人能腾出时间
senses.definition: free to see someone or do something; not busy
senses.definitionCN: 有空见人或做事；不忙
senses.example: The doctor is available at three o'clock.
senses.exampleCN: 医生三点有空。
senses.why: A person's time is a resource. When the schedule has an open slot, the person is available, like a room with no occupant.
senses.whyCN: 人的时间是资源。当日程中有空档，人就是 available，像一间没人占用的房间。

senses.title: Accessible to someone
senses.titleCN: 可供某人使用：对某人开放
senses.definition: able to be reached or used by a particular person or group
senses.definitionCN: 特定人或群体能够接触或使用
senses.example: The library is available to all students.
senses.exampleCN: 图书馆对所有学生开放。
senses.why: Access depends on permission and reach. Available to marks the group for whom the thing can be obtained or entered.
senses.whyCN: 访问取决于许可和可达性。available to 标出某物可被哪个群体获得或进入。

senses.title: Ready and at hand
senses.titleCN: 现成可用：就在手边
senses.definition: present and ready for immediate use
senses.definitionCN: 在场且可立即使用
senses.example: A first-aid kit is always available in the car.
senses.exampleCN: 车里总有一套现成的急救包。
senses.why: This is the spatial core: the thing is near enough to be taken now. Availability is not only permission but proximity and readiness.
senses.whyCN: 这是空间核心：东西近得现在就能拿。available 不只是许可，还是距离近和准备就绪。

senses.title: For sale or in stock
senses.titleCN: 有现货：可以买到
senses.definition: able to be bought or found in a shop
senses.definitionCN: 能够在商店买到或找到
senses.example: The new model is available from next week.
senses.exampleCN: 新款从下周起有售。
senses.why: Commerce adds a market condition: the item exists, is not sold out, and can be bought. Available becomes the shop's word for 'in stock'.
senses.whyCN: 商业增加了市场条件：物品存在、没卖光、可以买。available 成为商店里“有现货”的说法。

senses.title: Valid or effective
senses.titleCN: 有效：能够产生作用（旧义）
senses.definition: valid or effective; capable of producing the desired effect; older formal use
senses.definitionCN: 有效；能产生预期效果；较旧正式用法
senses.example: The old law is no longer available as a remedy.
senses.exampleCN: 这条旧法律不再能作为救济手段。
senses.why: The earliest recorded sense was 'beneficial, valid, effective'. Something available had the power to work, before the modern sense of 'at one's disposal'.
senses.whyCN: 最早记录的义项是“有益的、有效的、能产生效果的”。available 曾指有起作用的力量，早于现代“可支配”义。

senses.title: A computing resource that can be used
senses.titleCN: 计算机可用：资源可被分配
senses.definition: ready to be used by a system or process; computing
senses.definitionCN: 可供系统或进程使用；计算机用语
senses.example: The server has four available cores.
senses.exampleCN: 服务器有四个可用核心。
senses.why: A system tracks which resources are free and which are busy. Available marks the free ones that a process may claim, the same 'ready to be used' idea.
senses.whyCN: 系统追踪哪些资源空闲、哪些忙碌。available 标出可被进程申请的空闲资源，仍是“可被使用”的概念。

intro.en: Available is a home-grown English adjective: avail + -able. Its oldest sense was 'effective, valid', and only in the 19th century did 'at one's disposal' become the dominant meaning.
intro.cn: available 是英语本土构成的形容词：avail + -able。它最早的义项是“有效的、能起作用的”，直到 19 世纪，“可支配”才成为主要义项。

items.en: First recorded meaning 'beneficial' and 'valid, effective, capable of producing the desired effect'.
items.cn: 最早记录意为“有益的”以及“有效的、能产生预期效果的”。

items.en: avail (v.) is from around 1300, 'to help, assist; benefit, be profitable to; have force or efficacy'.
items.cn: avail（动词）约 1300 年出现，意为“帮助、协助；有益、对……有利；有力量、有效力”。

items.en: Apparently an Anglo-French compound of a- 'to' + vaill-, present stem of valoir 'be worth', from Latin valere 'be strong, be worth'.
items.cn: 大概是 Anglo-French 的 a-“向”+ vaill-（valoir“有价值”的现在时词干）复合词，源自拉丁语 valere“强壮、有价值”。

items.en: valere goes back to PIE *wal- 'to be strong'.
items.cn: valere 可追溯到原始印欧语 *wal-“强壮”。

items.en: The modern sense 'at one's disposal, capable of being made use of' is recorded from 1827.
items.cn: 现代义“可支配、能被利用”记录于 1827 年。

items.en: Availability is the noun, recorded from 1803. Unavailable negates the adjective with un-.
items.cn: 名词 availability 记录于 1803 年。unavailable 用 un- 构成否定。

note.en: The first group is about words that look or sound like available; the second is about other adjectives of access and readiness.
note.cn: 第一组看词形或读音接近 available 的词；第二组看其他表示“可获得、就绪”的形容词。

entries.definition: able to be avoided. It shares -able but comes from avoid, not avail.
entries.definitionCN: 可避免的。它同样以 -able 结尾，但来自 avoid，不是 avail。

entries.definition: worth a lot of money or importance. It comes from value, a different root.
entries.definitionCN: 值钱的；有价值的。它来自 value，词根不同。

entries.definition: likely to change. It comes from vary, not from avail.
entries.definitionCN: 易变的；变量。它来自 vary，不是 avail。

entries.definition: the word itself; note the four syllables and the unstressed first syllable.
entries.definitionCN: 本词；注意四个音节和轻读的第一音节。

entries.definition: able to be reached or entered. It stresses physical or institutional access.
entries.definitionCN: 可到达的；可进入的。它强调物理或制度上的访问。

entries.definition: able to be obtained. It is more formal and narrower than available.
entries.definitionCN: 可获得的。它比 available 更正式、更窄。

entries.definition: not busy or not occupied. It is the everyday word for an available person or seat.
entries.definitionCN: 不忙的；空闲的。它是描述人有空或座位空着的日常词。

entries.definition: fit to be used. It stresses condition and function rather than access.
entries.definitionCN: 可用的。它强调状态和功能，而不是获取途径。

entries.definition: present in a shop and ready to sell. It is the commercial phrase closest to available.
entries.definitionCN: 有现货。它是最接近 available 的商业短语。

normalIntro.en: Real links: avail + -able, the valere 'be worth' family, and the modern sense 'at one's disposal'.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：avail + -able、valere“有价值”词族，以及现代义“可支配”。

normal.en: avail + -able = 'can be availed of'. If you can avail yourself of it, it is available.
normal.cn: avail + -able =“能被利用”。如果你能利用它，它就是 available。

normal.en: Avail goes back to Latin valere 'be worth, be strong'. Something available is literally something of use and force.
normal.cn: avail 可追溯到拉丁语 valere“有价值、有力量”。available 字面上就是有用、有力量的东西。

normal.en: Valid, value and prevail share valere: they all involve strength or worth.
normal.cn: valid、value、prevail 共享 valere：都涉及力量或价值。

normal.en: Available to a group means open to them; available from a shop means in stock. The preposition changes the kind of access.
normal.cn: available to a group 表示对他们开放；available from a shop 表示有现货。介词改变访问方式。

normal.en: A person is available when there is an open slot in the schedule, like an unoccupied room.
normal.cn: 当日程中有空档，人就是 available，像一间没人住的房间。

abstract.en: Abstractly, available is a readiness predicate: a thing or person is in a state where it can be obtained, used, or reached.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，available 是一个“就绪”谓词：某物或某人处于可以被获得、使用或接触的状态。

abstract.en: The readiness can be physical (at hand), commercial (in stock), social (free), institutional (open to), or technical (a free resource).
abstract.cn: 这种就绪可以是物理的（在手边）、商业的（有现货）、社交的（有空）、制度的（对……开放）或技术的（资源空闲）。

abstract.en: So available does not name a property of the thing alone; it names a relation between the thing and someone who could use it.
abstract.cn: 所以 available 不只命名事物自身的性质，而命名事物与潜在使用者之间的关系。

examples.en: Is this room available for the weekend?
examples.cn: 这个房间周末有空吗？

examples.en: The report is available on the department's website.
examples.cn: 这份报告可以在部门网站上获取。

examples.en: We used every available resource to finish the project.
examples.cn: 我们用了所有可用资源来完成这个项目。

dict_mnemonic.text: “阿维勒波”——阿维勒波指着货架：这款电池还有现货，随时能拿走 → available 可获得的、有空的

root: avail + -able；avail 源自拉丁语 valere“有力量、有价值”，核心是“能被利用的”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of available, all built on one readiness relation: something or someone is in a state where it can be obtained, used, reached, or bought. The readiness may be physical, personal, institutional, commercial, legal, or technical.
sensesIntro.cn: available 的八个义项都建立在一个“就绪”关系上：某物或某人处于可以被获得、使用、接触或购买的状态。这种就绪可以是物理的、个人的、制度的、商业的、法律的或技术的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an object sits on a shelf, ready to be taken by whoever needs it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件东西放在货架上，随时可被需要它的人拿走。

branches.en: OBTAIN AND USE: a thing can be got and put to work, including a computing resource.
branches.cn: 获得与使用：东西能被拿到并派上用场，包括计算机资源。

branches.en: READY PERSON OR THING: a person is free, or an object is at hand and ready now.
branches.cn: 就绪的人或物：人有空，或东西在手边、现在就能用。

branches.en: OPEN ACCESS: a group is allowed to reach or use the thing.
branches.cn: 开放访问：某个群体被允许接触或使用该物。

branches.en: COMMERCE: the item is in stock and can be bought.
branches.cn: 商业：物品有现货，可以买到。

branches.en: VALIDITY: an older sense says the thing has force and can produce an effect.
branches.cn: 有效性：较旧的义项表示该物有力量、能产生效果。

intro.en: Available builds availability, unavailable, avail and availably. The -ability and un- forms are the productive parts.
intro.cn: available 构成 availability、unavailable、avail、availably。-ability 与 un- 是能产部分。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is built on valere 'to be strong, be worth' (PIE *wal-): valid, value and prevail all involve strength or worth.
latinIntro.cn: 这一拉丁词族建立在 valere“强壮、有价值”（原始印欧语 *wal-）上：valid、value、prevail 都涉及力量或价值。

items.meaning: the state of being available
items.meaningCN: 可用性；可获得性（-ity 构成名词）
items.example: Availability of staff is a scheduling problem.
items.exampleCN: 人员可用性是排班问题。

items.meaning: not able to be obtained or used
items.meaningCN: 不可用的；没空的（un- 表示否定）
items.example: The manager is unavailable this morning.
items.exampleCN: 经理今天上午没空。

items.meaning: to be of use or benefit
items.meaningCN: 有助于；利用（基础动词）
items.example: Nothing availed against the storm.
items.exampleCN: 面对暴风雨，什么都无济于事。

items.meaning: in an available manner; rare
items.meaningCN: 可获取地（-ly 构成副词，较少见）
items.example: The data were availably stored.
items.exampleCN: 数据被以可获取的方式存储。

items.meaning: to provide or release something for use

definition_en: the mathematical mean, a typical level, or to calculate or amount to a mean
core_image: 把高低不同的柱子削平，填到低处，得到一条水平线

senses.title: The arithmetic mean
senses.titleCN: 平均数：总和除以个数
senses.definition: the number obtained by adding quantities and dividing by their number
senses.definitionCN: 把若干数量相加再除以个数所得的数值
senses.example: The average of 2, 4 and 9 is 5.
senses.exampleCN: 2、4、9 的平均数是 5。
senses.why: The mathematical sense is recorded from 1755. It takes the older idea of equal sharing and turns it into a precise calculation: total divided by count.
senses.whyCN: 数学义记录于 1755 年。它把更古老的“均分”概念变成精确计算：总数除以个数。

senses.title: A typical or normal level
senses.titleCN: 平均水平：常见的高低
senses.definition: the usual or typical level of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物通常或典型的水平
senses.example: Her score was above the class average.
senses.exampleCN: 她的分数高于班级平均水平。
senses.why: Once a mean exists, it becomes a benchmark. Anything near it is called average, because it is near the calculated centre.
senses.whyCN: 一旦平均值存在，它就成为基准。接近它的东西就叫 average，因为它接近计算出的中心。

senses.title: Ordinary or mediocre
senses.titleCN: 普通的；平庸的：不出众
senses.definition: not special or excellent; ordinary
senses.definitionCN: 不特别、不出色；普通
senses.example: The food was average, nothing memorable.
senses.exampleCN: 食物很普通，没什么难忘的。
senses.why: The statistical centre becomes an evaluation. If you are exactly at the middle, you are not above it; average can therefore mean 'merely ordinary'.
senses.whyCN: 统计中心变成一种评价。如果你正好在中间，就不在它之上；因此 average 可以表示“只是普通”。

senses.title: Calculate the mean
senses.titleCN: 计算平均值：求平均
senses.definition: to calculate the arithmetic mean of quantities
senses.definitionCN: 计算若干数量的算术平均值
senses.example: Average the three measurements.
senses.exampleCN: 把这三个测量值取平均。
senses.why: The verb is recorded from 1831. It names the act that produces the noun: add the parts and divide to find the centre.
senses.whyCN: 动词记录于 1831 年。它命名产生名词的动作：把各部分相加再除，找出中心。

senses.title: Amount to a mean
senses.titleCN: 平均为：数值达到某个平均
senses.definition: to amount to a particular mean on average
senses.definitionCN: 平均达到某个数值
senses.example: Sales average ten thousand units a month.
senses.exampleCN: 销量平均每月一万件。
senses.why: Here the subject is a series and the object is the mean it reaches. The verb reports where the centre falls over time.
senses.whyCN: 这里主语是一串数值，宾语是它达到的平均值。动词报告这个中心随时间落在哪里。

senses.title: Distribute evenly; average out
senses.titleCN: 平均分配：把高低抹平
senses.definition: to distribute or balance differences so that they even out
senses.definitionCN: 分配或平衡差异，使其趋于平均
senses.example: The gains and losses averaged out over the year.
senses.exampleCN: 盈亏在一年中相互抵消，趋于平均。
senses.why: Differences are reduced by spreading them. Average out pictures the tall columns being cut and filled into the low ones until a level line appears.
senses.whyCN: 差异通过摊平而减小。average out 想象把高柱削平、填进低处，直到出现一条水平线。

senses.title: Maritime average loss
senses.titleCN: 海事平均损失：分摊海损
senses.definition: a loss or charge shared among owners of goods on a ship; historical maritime law
senses.definitionCN: 船货各方分摊的损失或费用；历史海事法
senses.example: General average required all owners to contribute.
senses.exampleCN: 共同海损要求所有货主分摊。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, from late 15th-century maritime trade. When cargo was thrown overboard to save a ship, all owners shared the loss proportionally.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，来自 15 世纪晚期的海上贸易。为救船而把货物抛下海时，所有货主按比例分摊损失。

senses.title: A batting average
senses.titleCN: 击球率：体育统计的平均值
senses.definition: a sports statistic expressed as a mean, especially in cricket and baseball
senses.definitionCN: 用平均值表示的体育统计，尤用于板球和棒球
senses.example: His batting average fell after the injury.
senses.exampleCN: 受伤后他的击球率下降了。
senses.why: Sport applies the mean to performance. A batting average divides hits by attempts, turning a player's record into one comparable number.
senses.whyCN: 体育把平均值用于表现。击球率用命中数除以尝试数，把球员的记录变成一个可比较的数字。

senses.title: On average
senses.titleCN: 平均而言：固定短语
senses.definition: in the phrase on average, meaning 'as a typical amount'
senses.definitionCN: 用于 on average，表示“按平均计算”
senses.example: On average, the train arrives five minutes late.
senses.exampleCN: 平均而言，火车晚点五分钟。
senses.why: The phrase treats the mean as a standpoint. To speak on average is to speak from the centre rather than from any single case.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语把平均值当作一个立足点。on average 是从中心而不是从任一单个案例说话。

senses.title: The law of averages
senses.titleCN: 平均法则：固定短语
senses.definition: the informal principle that results tend to even out over many trials
senses.definitionCN: 结果在多次试验后趋于均衡的非正式原则
senses.example: By the law of averages, he was due for a win.
senses.exampleCN: 按平均法则，他该赢一次了。
senses.why: The phrase turns the mean into an expectation about the future. Extremes are expected to be balanced by opposite extremes over time.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语把平均值变成对未来的期待。长期看，极端会被相反的极端平衡。

intro.en: Average began in Mediterranean shipping, not in mathematics. It named a loss shared among cargo owners, then became 'equal share', then 'typical level', and finally the arithmetic mean.
intro.cn: average 起源于地中海航运，而不是数学。它原指货主分摊的损失，后来变成“均摊”，再变成“典型水平”，最后成为算术平均数。

items.en: First recorded as 'a small charge over freight cost paid to the master of a ship', and 'a financial loss through damage to goods in transit'.
items.cn: 最早记录为“付给船长的额外运费”，以及“货物在运输中受损造成的经济损失”。

items.en: From French avarie 'damage to ship' and Italian avaria, words of 12th-century Mediterranean maritime trade.
items.cn: 来自法语 avarie“船损”和意大利语 avaria，是 12 世纪地中海海上贸易用词。

items.en: The origin is uncertain. It is sometimes traced to Arabic 'awariya 'damaged merchandise', but OED argues that is a modern word derived from the western use. Treat the Arabic link as unproved.
items.cn: 来源不确定。有时被追溯到阿拉伯语 'awariya“受损货物”，但《牛津英语词典》认为那是从西方用法派生的现代词。阿拉伯语联系应视为未证实。

items.en: The maritime sense developed into 'equal sharing of loss by the interested parties', then 'a medial estimate' by 1735.
items.cn: 海事义发展出“有关各方均摊损失”，再到 1735 年的“中间估计”。

items.en: The mathematical sense 'a mean proportion arrived at by arithmetical calculation' is recorded from 1755.
items.cn: 数学义“通过算术计算得出的平均比例”记录于 1755 年。

items.en: The adjective average 'estimated by averaging' is from 1770; the verb 'to amount to' is from 1769.
items.cn: 形容词 average“按平均估算的”出现于 1770 年；动词“平均为”出现于 1769 年。

note.en: The first group is about similar spelling and the abbreviation; the second is about other words for a middle value or an ordinary thing.
note.cn: 第一组看相似拼写和缩写；第二组看其他表示“中间值、普通”的词。

entries.definition: extreme greed for money. It shares the av- opening but has a completely different origin.
entries.definitionCN: 对金钱的极度贪婪。它同样以 av- 开头，但来源完全不同。

entries.definition: to state firmly; formal. It is a different word with a different root.
entries.definitionCN: 坚定地断言；正式。它是另一个词，词根不同。

entries.definition: the past tense and participle of average.
entries.definitionCN: average 的过去式和过去分词。

entries.definition: the written abbreviation for average in tables and sports.
entries.definitionCN: 表格和体育中 average 的书面缩写。

entries.definition: the arithmetic average in statistics. It is the technical synonym of average in sense 1.
entries.definitionCN: 统计学中的算术平均数。它是 average 第一义的术语同义词。

entries.definition: the middle value when numbers are ordered. It is not the same as the mean.
entries.definitionCN: 数字排序后位于中间的值。它与平均数不同。

entries.definition: showing the usual qualities of a group. It is close to average in sense 2.
entries.definitionCN: 显示一个群体的通常特征。它接近 average 第二义。

entries.definition: not special or unusual. It is close to average in sense 3 but less statistical.
entries.definitionCN: 不特别、不异常。它接近 average 第三义，但统计意味更少。

entries.definition: conforming to a standard or usual level. It is broader and often evaluative.
entries.definitionCN: 符合标准或通常水平。它更宽，常带评价性。

normalIntro.en: Real links: the maritime loss-sharing origin, the arithmetic mean, and the fixed phrases on average and law of averages.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：海事分摊损失的来源、算术平均数，以及 on average、law of averages 固定短语。

normal.en: The oldest image is maritime: cargo owners share a loss proportionally. Average begins as 'equal share of damage'.
normal.cn: 最古老的意象是海事：货主按比例分摊损失。average 从“损失均摊”开始。

normal.en: Mathematically, average = sum divided by count. The centre is found by adding all the parts and dividing.
normal.cn: 数学上，average = 总和 ÷ 个数。把所有部分相加再除，就找到中心。

normal.en: On average is a fixed phrase: speak from the centre, not from any single case.
normal.cn: on average 是固定短语：从中心说话，而不是从单个案例。

normal.en: The law of averages is informal: over many trials, extremes tend to balance out.
normal.cn: law of averages 是非正式说法：多次试验后，极端趋于平衡。

normal.en: Above average and below average place a value on either side of the calculated centre.
normal.cn: above average 和 below average 把一个值放在计算中心的任一侧。

abstract.en: Abstractly, average is a centre-finding operation: unequal parts are summed and divided so that one representative number can stand for the whole.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，average 是一种找中心的操作：不等的部分被相加再除，使一个代表性数字能代表整体。

abstract.en: The centre then becomes a benchmark (above/below average), an evaluation (merely average), and even a prediction (the law of averages).
abstract.cn: 这个中心随后变成基准（高于/低于平均）、评价（只是普通），甚至预测（平均法则）。

abstract.en: So average moves from sharing a loss, to measuring a set, to judging a thing, to expecting the future: one centre, four uses.
abstract.cn: 所以 average 从分摊损失，到测量集合，到评价事物，再到期待未来：一个中心，四种用途。

examples.en: The average of the five test scores was 82.
examples.cn: 五次测验的平均分是 82。

examples.en: On average, students spend two hours on homework.
examples.cn: 平均而言，学生花两小时做作业。

examples.en: The film was average, but the acting was excellent.
examples.cn: 这部电影很普通，但演技出色。

dict_mnemonic.text: “阿维瑞吉”——阿维瑞吉把高高低低的分数削平，算出一条平均线 → average 平均数、普通的

root: 晚期中古英语，来自法语 avarie / 意大利语 avaria“船损”，原指海事损失分摊；更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Ten senses of average, all built on one centre: unequal parts are shared out until a level line appears. The centre is first a maritime loss share, then a mathematical mean, then a typical level, then an evaluation of ordinariness, and finally a phrase for expectation.
sensesIntro.cn: average 的十个义项都建立在一个中心上：不等的部分被摊平，直到出现一条水平线。这个中心先是海事损失分摊，再是算术平均数，再是典型水平，再是对“普通”的评价，最后成为表达期待的短语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: tall columns are cut down and the excess is filled into the low places, producing a level line.
core.cn: 核心意象：高的柱子被削低，多出的部分填进低处，最终形成一条水平线。

branches.en: MEAN: the arithmetic centre is defined, calculated, or reported as an amount.
branches.cn: 平均数：算术中心被定义、计算，或作为一个数值被报告。

branches.en: TYPICAL AND ORDINARY: the centre becomes a benchmark, then a judgment of mediocrity.
branches.cn: 典型与普通：中心先成为基准，再成为对平庸的判断。

branches.en: EVEN OUT: differences are balanced by distributing them, as in average out.
branches.cn: 摊平：差异通过分配而平衡，如 average out。

branches.en: MARITIME: the oldest sense, a loss shared among cargo owners.
branches.cn: 海事：最古老的义项，货主之间分摊损失。

branches.en: SPORT AND PHRASES: batting average, on average and the law of averages apply the centre to performance and expectation.
branches.cn: 体育与短语：击球率、on average、law of averages 把中心用于表现与期待。

intro.en: Average builds averagely, averageness and averaging, and forms fixed phrases and compounds such as on average and batting average. The -ly and -ness suffixes are productive.
intro.cn: average 构成 averagely、averageness、averaging，并形成 on average、batting average 等固定短语和复合词。-ly、-ness 是能产后缀。

latinIntro.en: Average has no reliable Latin cognate. Its known path is French and Italian maritime vocabulary, with a deeper origin that is uncertain, so the Latin list is left empty rather than filled with guesses.
latinIntro.cn: average 没有可靠的拉丁同族词。它可考的路径是法语和意大利语的海事词汇，更深来源不确定，因此拉丁词条留空，而不用猜测填充。

items.meaning: to an average degree
items.meaningCN: 平均地；普通地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: The team performed averagely.
items.exampleCN: 团队表现平平。

items.meaning: the quality of being average
items.meaningCN: 平均；平庸（-ness 构成性质名词）
items.example: The averageness of the design disappointed critics.
items.exampleCN: 设计的平庸让评论家失望。

items.meaning: the process of calculating a mean
items.meaningCN: 平均计算（-ing 构成动名词或分词）
items.example: The averaging of the data took an hour.
items.exampleCN: 数据的平均计算花了一小时。

items.meaning: calculated as a mean; balanced out
items.meaningCN: 取平均的；平均的（-ed 构成分词或形容词）
items.example: The averaged results are shown below.
items.exampleCN: 平均后的结果如下所示。

items.meaning: to balance differences over time
items.meaningCN: 平均起来；使均衡（短语动词）
items.example: The highs and lows average out.
items.exampleCN: 高峰和低谷会相互抵消。

items.meaning: as a typical amount
items.meaningCN: 平均而言（固定短语）
items.example: On average, the journey takes an hour.
items.exampleCN: 平均而言，这段旅程需要一小时。

items.meaning: higher than the mean
items.meaningCN: 高于平均的（above + average 复合形容词）
items.example: She earns an above-average salary.
items.exampleCN: 她的薪水高于平均。

items.meaning: lower than the mean
items.meaningCN: 低于平均的（below + average 复合形容词）
items.example: The crop was below-average this year.
items.exampleCN: 今年收成低于平均。

items.meaning: a hitter's mean performance statistic
items.meaningCN: 击球率（batting + average 复合名词）
items.example: His batting average improved this season.
items.exampleCN: 他的击球率本赛季提高了。

items.meaning: the informal principle that extremes balance out over many trials
items.meaningCN: 平均法则（固定短语）
items.example: By the law of averages, they will win eventually.
items.exampleCN: 按平均法则，他们最终会赢。
